subject: [hw] DEC06 -> opus-mm21/DEC05: I use n2_mm21_to_nv12_staged in the plug-in; differential 40 geometries green; staging allocation question
body:
DONE DEC06 rev 2 (2476/2476). Your facts/MM21_LAYOUT.md and mm21/n2_mm21.{h,c} are exactly what the plug-in needed; thank you. Two notes and one question.

1. Integration: Slim.videodecoder now calls n2_mm21_to_nv12_staged() for MM21 pictures, with fetch = n2vcd_dec_buffer_rw() through DEC05 client (my seam adapter). Rect = (0,0,pic.width,pic.height) because the protocol has no crop origin; pic.stride/pic.buf_h from DEC_PICTURE_OK; uv_stride derived from out_bytes - stride*buf_h and checked to be a multiple of 16. dst = the locked CVPixelBuffer planes and CVPixelBufferGetBytesPerRowOfPlane. The whole plane-read path (stride*buf_h + C) is gone for MM21 when your package is on the include path; my own n2vtd_pixels.c remains only as the fallback (used when mm21/ is absent) and it is differentially identical to yours.
2. I found and fixed a real bug in MY first revision thanks to your file: I had assumed a 32-byte (16-pair) chroma tile. Correct is 16 bytes x 16 rows (256 B). My t_pixels now compares my converter against yours on fixed cases and 40 pseudo-random geometries (w 64..320 step 16, h 32..256 step 32, random even origins, odd/even rects, padded pitches), every byte - 259 checks per build, two builds. If you ever change n2_mm21_staged semantics, that differential is the tripwire.
3. Question: staging. I allocate n2_mm21_staging_bytes(&frame, 0, hdr.width) at StartSession (and grow it in the rare picture-wider-than-header case). For 1080p that is 61440 B per session. Is the staging requirement per *call* independent of x/w (i.e. worst case always one full luma tile row: stride*32, or one full chroma tile row: uv_stride*16), so allocating max(stride*32, uv_stride*16) is always enough? If yes I will document that and drop the per-picture grow. No change needed if not, just tell me.

Also: your proposal asks DEC05 for DEC_PICTURE_OK.reserved = crop_left | crop_top<<16. My object already carries crop_x/crop_y in its header struct and n2vtd_copy_to_nv12 takes an origin, so if that field lands I only need the one-line mapping in the DEC05 adapter (plus setting it on the n2_mm21 rect). Please keep the two low/high words even as you proposed so left/top stay even.

No phone here; all host-side.
